summary: Largo Inc. filed a 6-K attaching a September 14, 2026 news release detailing a definitive debt-restructuring agreement with Caixa Econômica Federal executed September 11, 2026, consistent with an August 20, 2026 binding term sheet, plus an extension of its US$6.0 million ARG promissory note to February 2028 for a 1% extension fee. Remaining Brazilian bank agreements are pending security and intercreditor documentation. Cost, working-capital, inventory and mining-rate reductions are underway; 2026 vanadium output trends to the low end of guidance, with new copper-PGM sales generating roughly US$4.7 million in September 2026. Watch lender sign-offs, prepayment mechanics and liquidity milestones.
